result.summary: ISS-0159 (GH #480) and ISS-0160 (GH #481) both resolved. tests/integration/entity_subsystem_test.zig: 10/12 with 3 leaks -> 12/12 with ZERO leaks. ISS-0159 root cause: createRecord's duplicate branch called fetchRecordResult with the freshly-minted record_id (never persisted on a replay, so zero rows matched -> InvalidRecord) instead of the original event's, which sits in append_res.record.payload; and it never freed append_res.record, whose event_type/payload/metadata are allocator-owned on the duplicate path (rowToEventRecord dupes exactly 3 strings = the 3 reported leaks) but borrowed on the fresh path (duplicateFromParams sets them to ""). Fix: new extractRecordId() helper recovers the original id from the replayed payload; a single unconditional 'var append_record = append_res.record; defer append_record.deinit(allocator);' handles both ownership shapes (EventRecord.deinit guards on .len > 0) and was added to createRecord, updateRecord AND deleteRecord. ISS-0160 root cause: payload validation was a literal TODO at commands.zig:103 and InvalidPayload was declared but returned nowhere in src/entities/. Fix: new validateRecordPayload() in validator.zig translates the entity definition's fields array into a JSON Schema and delegates to src/tools/json_schema.zig's validateCollect (ISS-0155), mirroring registry.zig's validatePayloadAgainstSchema - no second validator was written. Called before the append in BOTH createRecord and updateRecord, so a rejected create leaves no event and no projection row. INCIDENTAL FIX (ISS-0133 class): validator.zig's test blocks were in no addTest root's file set and never ran; proven with a deliberately-failing canary that left 'zig build test' green at 63/63. build.zig now registers validator.zig as its own test root; re-injecting the canary turned the build red, confirming the wiring. Unit test count 837 -> 856. All three fixes mutation-verified independently.

issues.description: entity_subsystem_test is flaky against the shared TestHarness via two independent cross-binary races: (A) C23505 on schema_migrations_schema_version_uq for schema_name='tenant_default', which cascades OutOfOrderMigration into every later block in the binary; (B) resetTestData deleting a live test's instance_projections mid-test, surfacing as InstanceNotFound and a lost idempotency row. Both reproduce with the ISS-0159/0160 changes stashed and are in shared harness code, not src/entities/. Explicitly NOT a duplicate of #483/ISS-0151 (that one is schema_name=tenant_<uuid> explained by the clean_test_db sweep, which excludes tenant_default). Filed + QUEUED.

Pre-existing and already QUEUED: lint_test_wiring.py exits 1 on a third unattached artifact, run_probe_svc_tests, which is not on its known-list (unlike run_differential_tests and run_iss105_integration_tests). Reproduces with my changes stashed. Not fixed here because build.zig was being concurrently edited by the ISS-0154/LUA agent in the same run. Documented as a comment on GH #476 rather than filed as a duplicate.
